title: enchantment golden apple crafting
description: This datapack adds enchantment golden apple recipe
body:
**I know,the enchantment golden apple is very importmant**
but we can't craft it in the new versions
### so this datapack help us
This datapack adds a recipe for the enchantment golden apple

**But how?**

Simply;an apple in the center and 8 gold blocks,expensive, but the result is worthwhile.
